title: fix(objectql): list a runtime-authored bound action on the object it names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNx?thread=cmsg_01LjZwNRFiG2fkp8SNf6rHNxQLLDJM47eag51AoZaxz8Ha)_

Fixes #28356

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 运行时经元数据入口（`PUT /api/v1/meta/action/NAME`、Studio、AI）保存的、带 `objectName` 的独立 action，现在会挂到它所指对象的 `actions` 上；删除后立即从对象上撤下。
- **为什么改：** 之前注册表只把代码包发布的绑定 action 挂到对象上，运行时保存的 action 能执行却不出现在任何对象界面上，保存成功但用户找不到按钮。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改 `SchemaRegistry` 读时挂接的取数范围与两处删除时的缓存失效；启动期审计仍只看代码包 action。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `boundServedActions`（同名 bare key 遮蔽 composite key 的那一行）；同文件 `removeOverlayEntry` / `removeRuntimeShadow` 新增的 `invalidateAll`；`packages/objectql/src/bound-action-foreign-object.test.ts` 新增 describe 块。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/bound-action-foreign-object.test.ts`，预期 23 passed；新块 5 条覆盖保存、重存、删除、无目标对象、overlay 替换。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `SchemaRegistry.attachBoundActions` now attaches every bound standalone `action` the registry serves (new private `boundServedActions`), not only code-shipped ones. A runtime row reaches the registry through the save door's write-through and the boot's `sys_metadata` hydration; it was dispatchable through the router's rung 2 but listed on no served object, so no client drew it.
- One item per name, with `getItem`'s precedence: a bare-key entry (an ADR-0005 overlay) shadows the composite entries of its name, so the attached entry is the declaration rung 2 resolves.
- The boot audits (`findUnboundActionTargets`, the bound-action collision audit) keep reading the code-only population, so a runtime action naming a missing object never fails a boot.
- `removeOverlayEntry` and `removeRuntimeShadow` (the delete heal's tiers) now drop the cached object folds when they retire an `action` entry, as `unregisterItem` already did. Without it a deleted runtime action stayed listed on the cached object.
- The registry holds no org-scoped row (the protocol's hydration declines one), so the attach crosses no organization.

## Tests

- New describe block in `packages/objectql/src/bound-action-foreign-object.test.ts` (real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` + real registry):
  - saved action is listed by `getMetaItem` object, `getMetaItems` object and `registry.getObject`, after the owner's own actions; control object unchanged;
  - attached entry is the rung 2 declaration by reference;
  - re-save serves the new body; delete withdraws it from the cached object and from the served read;
  - a runtime action naming a missing object is listed nowhere and `findUnboundActionTargets()` stays empty;
  - a bare-key overlay of a packaged bound action is attached in its place, and lifting the shadow serves the packaged one again.
- Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed on disk, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  - attach population back to `boundCodeActions` ⇒ 4 of the new cases red;
  - invalidation removed from `removeOverlayEntry` ⇒ the delete case red;
  - invalidation removed from `removeRuntimeShadow` ⇒ the shadow-lift case red.
  - A first attempt at the second ablation was a no-op (replacement contained the anchor); the tool refused it before running, and it was redone with a marker.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` at 0b2103fc6: 505 files / 9828 tests passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

## Acceptance notes

- Not measured: a restart that rehydrates the stored row from `sys_metadata` (the dev server's `--fresh` store dies with the process). The hydrated row registers under the bare key, which the new population includes; the unit cases drive the write-through path.
- Out of scope, noted: `removeOverlayEntry` / `removeRuntimeShadow` also skip the fold invalidation for `picklist` entries, which `registerItem` / `unregisterItem` do invalidate. Not measured.
- The console side needs no change: `useConsoleActionRuntime` reads `objectDef.actions`, which now carries the action.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live: fresh todo server, before and after</summary>

`examples/app-todo` with `pnpm dev -- --fresh`, signed in as the seeded admin, then `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/rt_probe_action` with `objectName: todo_task`, `type: url`.

- origin/main 80b561be1: PUT 200; `GET /meta/action` lists `rt_probe_action`; `GET /meta/object/todo_task` and `GET /meta/object` list the 8 packaged actions only.
- This branch (objectql rebuilt): both object reads list the 8 actions then `rt_probe_action`; after `DELETE /meta/action/rt_probe_action` (200) the object lists the 8 again.

</details>
